title: rosa cinnamomea f. plena
intro: Rosa cinnamomea f. plena, commonly known as Double Yellow Rose, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Rosa cinnamomea f. plena include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative effects. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
